questions.question: What is a probability that a leap year has 53 Sundays.
questions.questionHtml: What is a probability that a leap year has 53 Sundays.
questions.solution:
Leap year has 366 days.

366/7 gives quotient as 52 and remainder as 2.
Hence, there will be 52 Sundays for sure.
2 days are extra after 52 Sundays/weeks.
These 2 days can be: (Sunday, Monday), (Monday, Tuesday), (Tuesday, Wednesday), (Wednesday, Thursday), (Thursday, Friday), (Friday, Saturday), (Saturday, Sunday)
Of these total 7 outcomes, the favorable outcomes are 2
Probability = 2/7
